# SOP-P2-L3-02 Product changeover - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, EQ-P2-L3-IH03

Preconditions
1. Line is in normal stop state and lockout/tagout is applied to EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, and EQ-P2-L3-IH03.  
2. Required parts and tooling staged at changeover location.  
3. The lubricant part number for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is CFW-LUB-225.  
4. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 1175 °C.

Required PPE
1. Safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear.  
2. Flame-resistant sleeves when accessing heated surfaces on EQ-P2-L3-IH03.  
3. Respiratory protection as required by local permit or if oil mist is present.

Standard changeover steps
1. Verify Precondition 1 and confirm lockout/tagout per SB-1036.  
2. Remove current tooling from EQ-P2-L3-RR01 and clean mounting surfaces. Inspect for wear and report deviations to maintenance.  
3. Install new tooling and fasteners. Confirm alignment per SOP-P2-L3-03.  
4. Replenish lubricant on EQ-P2-L3-RR01 using CFW-LUB-225. Record part number and batch in the changeover log.  
5. Verify heater control settings on EQ-P2-L3-IH03 and confirm ability to reach and maintain 1175 °C before introducing billet stock. Do not introduce material until stable.  
6. Bring EQ-P2-L3-HT02 to readiness state and verify interlocks. Perform dry run at no-load to confirm sequencing.  
7. Run pilot piece(s) and verify dimensions and surface condition. If unacceptable, escalate per SOP-P2-L3-05.

Completion and cleanup
1. Remove tooling debris and return spare parts to designated storage.  
2. Update production schedule and traceability records with changeover details.

Sign-off
Operator: ____________________  Date: __________  
Shift Supervisor: ______________  Date: __________

Related documents: SB-1036, SOP-P2-L3-03, SOP-P2-L3-05
